doc.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007

title: Closing and upcoming Armstrong festival in Hungary
summary: Wrap-up, thanks, and mention of an upcoming Louis Armstrong festival where he will emcee in Hungarian.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I enjoyed talking to you and I wish you the best of luck.
You’re going back overseas soon? You have something scheduled?
Oh I think in June I’ve got something. There’s an annual Louis Armstrong festival, this is the third annual.
And I’m sort of the jovial emcee in Hungarian.
Okay Rowe, Monk Rowe, it’s nice talking with you.
